faq.a: Nurlana is associated with the Arabic form نُورْلَانَا, whose core sense is nurlana; light (azerbaijani form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Nurlana?
faq.a: Nurlana is associated with Arabic. Nurlana is an Azerbaijani female given name formed from Arabic نُور (nūr, 'light').
Yes — the underlying form نُورْلَانَا is Arabic.
Nurlana can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nurlana should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.

faq.q: What does Nurlana mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Nurlana is rendered نورلانا and carries the sense نورلانا، روشنی.

faq.q: What does Nurlana mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nurlana is rendered نورلانا and carries the sense نورلانا، نور.
A romanized syllable approximation is nur-la-na. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nurlana?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nurlana, nurlana. Script forms are نورلانا, نُورْلَانَا, नूरलाना.

faq.q: Is Nurlana a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
